name: kanban
description: An outcome-first agent task board with durable results, verification evidence, artifacts, and bounded goal loops.
author: nathanyi96
highlights: One field to create a task — the board writes the title and summary for you
Choose Chat, Task Runner, Autopilot, or Auto routing when you create a card
Answer a permission request from the card itself, without opening the chat
Set each card's permission — Normal, Reads, or Trust — the same ladder chat uses
Review the latest outcome, verification evidence, artifacts, and attempts without reading the full chat
Use Continue until verified for bounded Task Runner loops with attempt, time, and token limits
Reply to Chat or give the next Task Runner attempt a corrective instruction from the drawer
Five columns with drag-and-drop, plus a tap-to-move path for touch screens
A card settles itself when its agent turn ends — including across recoveries
A run orphaned by a restart is reconciled on the next page load, not left stuck
